edict:cold_iron: Every blade in town bites deeper since that Law. The mages have gone very quiet about it.
My boy cut a fence post in half by accident. His sister can't light a candle any more.
edict:good_hunt: Never seen so many pelts on one cart. Never seen the wolves so bold, either.
The butcher's bought a new sign. The watchman's bought a bigger axe.
edict:still_water: The mages walk around looking very calm. I bumped one in the street and it felt like walking into a pillow.
Everyone's mana is up and nobody can throw a decent punch. The taverns have never been so polite.
edict:patient_stone: My grandfather's pick has outlasted him and it'll outlast me. Takes all day to get through a wall, mind.
The tools last for ever now. The work does too.
edict:open_palm: I dropped a coin yesterday, and it rolled uphill to someone else. I'm not joking.
Things just follow that hero around, they say. Saw a turnip go past me like it was late for something.
edict:good_hearth: The forge has never run so hot. You could bake bread on the doorstep.
Bricks in half the time! Bread's gone up, though. It's always bread.
edict:iron_purse: I sold my old boots for more than I paid for them. Then I had to buy new ones. I don't want to talk about it.
Everyone's selling. Everyone's rich. Nobody can afford anything. I don't understand any of it.
edict:open_door: Shops have their doors wide open and the prices right down. The guild hall looks like a funeral.
It's a good time to buy. It's a bad time to be owed money.
edict:lean_years: We all mend quick now, and we all go hungry quicker. The hunters come home with next to nothing.
My leg healed in a fortnight. There wasn't much in the larder to celebrate with.
edict:bright_tonic: One bowl of my wife's soup and I can lift the cart. If I skip the soup I can't lift the spoon.
The apothecary's a rich man now. A scratch still takes a month to go on its own.
edict:hard_shell: My armour's never fitted so well. I walk like a wardrobe, but I'm a very safe wardrobe.
The guards take a sword to the chest and just look annoyed. They don't get anywhere quickly, mind.
edict:light_step: I jumped the ditch! At my age! I landed badly, but I jumped it.
The children are on the roofs again. The healer's never been busier.
edict:pilgrim: The road goes by faster now. The priests say the prayers don't carry as far.
I was in the next town by noon. I can't say I felt very holy about it.
edict:wide_fields: There's deer all over the barley. And there's something after the deer. You can hear it at night.
Best hunting in years. Worst sleeping in years.
edict:witness: The temple's full, and they've put up the price of candles. Faith isn't cheap this year.
People keep saying they feel watched. Prices keep going up. I'm starting to think they're related.
edict:quiet_name: There was a wanted poster here this morning. I can't remember whose. Can you?
The guards are forgetting things. The bounty board's been nearly empty for a month.
edict:quick_hands: The farrier shoes a horse in the time it takes to sneeze. His hammer doesn't seem to hit as hard, though.
A pickpocket had my purse and put it back before I noticed. I only know because he told me.
edict:sure_hand: Every so often a blow just lands right, and you can hear it two streets away. Blades don't last, though.
My sword's gone back to the smith three times this month. Worth it. Mostly.
edict:heavy_hand: A man got thrown clean through a door last night. The door wasn't open.
The bar fights have got very short, and very far away.
edict:fletcher: My arrow went straight through the barn. Both walls. I was aiming at a rabbit.
The bowyers can't keep up. Nobody's arm seems as quick as it was, though.
edict:thorned_skin: I punched a man and it hurt me as much as him. He didn't even have his fists up.
You want to be careful who you hit these days. It's the Law, and I mean that literally.
edict:still_air: The arrow went right past him. Nothing moved. The arrow just decided against it.
My armour feels thinner lately. I swear my luck's better, though.
edict:ember_heart: The priest set the altar cloth on fire saying grace. Nobody's getting better from anything, either.
Candles light when you look at them too hard. Burns won't heal, mind.
edict:thin_well: A spell costs a thimbleful now. Filling the thimble takes all morning.
The hedge-witch says it's like drinking through a very small straw, but the drink is very strong.
edict:open_sky: Someone flew over the market yesterday, for ages, without a care in the world. Then I heard what happened to the last one who fell.
They say the sky's opened up. The ground's as hard as ever. Harder.
edict:tide: I swam the river in my boots! I can't get over the stile any more, but I swam the river.
The fishermen are all in the water now, and nobody's jumping off the pier.
edict:fair_wage: The guild pays twice what it did. The merchants pay half. I'm in the wrong job, and so are you.
Good money for a good day's killing. Try selling the pelt, though.
edict:blood_price: I saw a man take a sword in the arm, and then kill something and stand up straighter. I didn't like how he smiled.
They say a kill will close a wound now. I don't want to know who tried that first.
edict:shadow_step: There's someone in this room, you know. I've just got no idea who. Nobody has, lately.
The wolves walked right past my cart. I didn't breathe for an hour. My punches have gone to nothing, too.
edict:short_night: The sun was gone and back before I'd finished my supper. What came in that hour, though. I've never heard anything like it.
Nights go past in a blink. A very bad blink.
edict:glass_blade: I've seen a farmhand drop a boar with one swing. I saw a boar drop a farmhand the same way. Nobody wins a fight twice now.
It's over before it starts, these days. For everyone.
edict:storm_feet: Something went past me at the crossroads so fast it took my hat. It stopped at the wall. That didn't look good.
They say the hero's a blur now. They also say don't try to hug them.
edict:merchant_king: Half price! Half price, and they pay you more! I don't know what's going on, and neither does anyone else. There's blood on the counting tables.
The guild's out of money, the shops are full, and a man was stabbed over a sack of turnips.
edict:bottomless: The apprentice lit the whole hillside and didn't even sit down. The cut on his hand's been open for a month.
There's no end to it now, the mana. No end to the bleeding, either.
edict:golden_touch: They hit a vein at the old mine and it hasn't stopped. It's eaten eleven picks this week.
Everyone's digging. The smith's hired three boys just to carry the broken tools.
edict:second_sun: It was dark for about as long as it takes to say so. I've never been so frightened in my life.
Night's over before you've shut the door. Whatever comes in that time comes in fast.
edict:thirteenth_hour: There's an extra hour in the night now. Everyone's at the temple for it. You'd want to be, with what's outside.
I counted the bells. Thirteen. I counted again. Then I stopped counting, and I went to pray.
edict:hollow_king: He's got a wound in his side that's been open since the spring. It closes when he kills something. He's taken to walking at night.
There's a Law now that says the only cure is someone else. I don't think anyone asked us.
